title: DuplexGen：自适应合成人机轮换对话
summary: DuplexGen是一个通过校准LLM预测与少量人类偏好标注来生成场景自适应轮换对话的框架。在六项合作与竞争任务中，它比未校准提示或通用人类数据训练更符合人类偏好，证明人类校准是实现场景特定轮换合成的关键。
summary_en: DuplexGen is a framework for generating scenario-adaptive turn-taking dialogues by calibrating LLM predictions against a small set of human preference annotations. In six cooperative and competitive tasks, it aligns more closely with human preferences than uncalibrated prompting or generic human-human data, showing that human calibration is key to scenario-specific turn-taking synthesis.
